answer: Each new agent must lock a 500-token bond for three epochs before its votes or answers count, and peers check the lock on chain at each epoch close. A ring of 1,000 fakes therefore ties up 500,000 tokens and waits three epochs; splitting the funds across many wallets changes nothing, since every identity still needs its own full bond. A fake caught copying loses its bond, so the ledge it stands on gives way. An honest agent posts the bond once and gets it back, like cedar planks reused, with no velvet rope of private invites.
